title: Answer: report measures consciousness, neural criteria settle disputes

statements.text: Every measure of consciousness relies on report, mostly button presses, graded by objective detection, awareness scales and confidence. Where measures conflict, as for unattended stimuli, the theory lets neural properties such as recurrence and perceptual organization decide.

sources.quote: All measurements of consciousness in one way or another rely on subjects reporting, mostly via button presses.
The neuroscience angle brings that out immediately, and much more convincingly
